text_block_list.text:
I'm out buying a few things at the
shopping
district when I run into Hishi
Amazon with another
Miho dorm student
by chance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, what a coincidence! You out
shoppin' too,
Teach?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We just finished checkin' out that craft
store over
there.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've got the handiest hands
around,
don'tcha know? I do a lot of
needlework and
cooking.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Our clothes constantly get torn or frayed
with all
the running we do!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
One of the Miho students needed a
quick fix, so
we zipped over to use the
store's rental sewing
machine.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You really saved me, Hishiama! I didn't
know what
to do when my uniform
ripped.
text_block_list.name: Miho Student A

text_block_list.text:
It was nothing! Just promise me you'll
rest up
good and let your injury heal!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I will! Thank you so much! I'm going to
head back,
so I'll see you later!
text_block_list.name: Miho Student A

text_block_list.text: Yep! See you later!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I know livin' on your own can be tough,
so if you
ever need any help, just lemme
know, Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Just as I'm marveling at how caring Hishi
Amazon
is, I notice all the bags she's
carrying. Seems she's
done a bit of
personal shopping too.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! The store just stocked up on lots
of new
items, so I ended up grabbing a
bunch of stuff!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
My hobbies end up being pretty
practical since I
can mend clothes and
make little handicraft
accessories.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Hm? Hang on...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh! The hem of your jacket's coming
apart!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Man, what a mess. You're lucky I was the
one to
catch it!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hand it over! I'll mend it up for you in
the blink of
an eye!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list:
It's okay! I can do it myself, even if it takes a
while.

text_block_list.text:
Hand it over! I'll mend it up for you in
the blink of
an eye!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list:
It's okay! I can do it myself, even if it takes a
while.

text_block_list.text:
Haha, no worries! Let's go to the park
and find us
a bench!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I won't take but a second of your time!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон takes out her sewing kit
and makes
light work of the frayed hem.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: And that's that! Go on then, try it on!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Thank you, it looks brand new.

text_block_list.text: Heh, that was light work!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I found a hole in it mid-stitching, so I
went ahead
and fixed that up too!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I take a glance at my jacket and find a

leopard-print patch covering the hole in

question...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It gives your jacket a bit of flair,
don'tcha think?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Oh, and don't worry about payin' me
back! It's no
biggie!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You sure? Oh yeah, you're an adult! I'm
glad
you've got things under control.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Still, your jacket is startin' to look real
shabby.
It'd be better to fix it up
quickly.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Here, you can borrow my sewing kit—I
always
carry it with me!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон lends me her sewing kit. I
take a
seat on a park bench and start
fixing up my
jacket's hem, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Did you prick yourself with the needle?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
No worries?! We need to take care of it
now!
Hang on, I always keep some
bandages on me
too!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: All right, this should do it!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I can't help but notice the cute cat
design on the
bandage she puts on my
finger.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! This is sure to keep you from
being reckless
with that needle.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
The younger students love these. The
same goes
for the cute lunches I make!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You gotta be careful and stay safe,
okay, Teach?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Since she went out of her way to add
this little
touch, I feel extra motivated to
take good care of
my jacket.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
